t: This is the Foundling Museum on Brunswick Square in Bloomsbury. It tells the story of the Foundling Hospital, Britain's first home for children at risk of abandonment. Inside are the nationally important Foundling Hospital Collection and the Gerald Coke Handel Collection, an internationally important collection relating to Handel and his contemporaries. The museum reopened in June 2004 after a major refurbishment. The person behind it all is Captain Thomas Coram, a sea captain and philanthropist who created the Foundling Hospital to look after abandoned children on the streets of London. It is said to be the world's first incorporated charity.
